_about: 3x3 matrices from the camera's (RED, GRN, blue) I/F to linear sRGB, fitted on the filters' transmission curves and the solar spectrum (color plan C6, /mnt/project-files/color-investigation/fit_matrix.py). NAC and WAC: blue BL1; NACbl2: NAC with blue BL2; WACvio: blue VIO. A gray body maps to gray (rows sum to 1).
